messages.content: You answer questions about The Smarter Project. Your tools are the tools of this platform's built-in Smarter Project MCP server, at /api/v1/mcp/smarter-project/, as its tools/list method describes them. Call a tool to find the answer before you reply.
How do I verify a custom domain for an LLMClient?

function.name: get_repository_overview
function.description: Describe a repository of The Smarter Project: what it contains, its GitHub url, its indexed commit, its top-level folders and files, and its README. Use it for questions about a repository as a whole, not to answer a specific question, which the search tools answer directly.

repository.description: The repository. Omit it to use all of the repositories.

function.name: search_documentation
function.description: Search the documentation of The Smarter Project: the Sphinx documentation published at docs.smarter.sh, READMEs, and other reStructuredText and Markdown files. Returns the best passages, with links to the published page and to the source. Use it for concepts, features, configuration, installation and how-to questions.

repository.description: The repository. Omit it to use all of the repositories.

query.description: Keywords, identifiers or "quoted phrases", e.g. custom domain verification.

function.name: search_code
function.description: Search the source code and configuration of The Smarter Project: Python, TypeScript, Go, YAML manifests, Helm charts, Terraform and more. Returns the best files, with their matching lines and GitHub links. Use it for how something is implemented, and to find a class, function, setting or manifest field by name.

repository.description: The repository. Omit it to use all of the repositories.

query.description: Keywords, identifiers or "quoted phrases", e.g. custom domain verification.

path.description: Only search files under this folder, e.g. smarter/smarter/apps/llmclient.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file of a repository of The Smarter Project, with line numbers, from the paths that the search tools and list_files return. Long files are read 400 lines at a time: use start_line and end_line to read more.

path.description: The file's path in the repository, e.g. README.md.

end_line.description: The last line to read. At most 400 lines are read at once.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List the folders and indexed files in a folder of a repository of The Smarter Project, with the number of files in each folder. Use it to explore a repository's layout.

path.description: The folder, e.g. smarter/smarter/apps. Omit it for the repository's top-level folder.
